Systolic/diastolic are paired values within one heartbeat; maximum/minimum is not hypertension/hypotension diagnosis. No new diagnostic numerical threshold invented.

BP variation retains posture/activity/mind/disease/time and premeasurement conditions; excitement/tension/sleep loss/sudden exercise/temperature/straining/holding urinary or bowel urge remain explicit, with no request to hold elimination for staff schedule.

Two differing BP measurements retain both values and each condition/time/posture/activity; activity does not authorize ignoring abnormal value or one-measurement onset/cure diagnosis. Contact/recheck follows individual plan/facility procedure.

Persistent high BP may occur without headache or other subjective symptoms; actual measurement and explicit medical-professional evaluation retained. Lifestyle/genetic factors and other disease such as kidney disease distinguished; heart burden from hypertension is not a claim that every heart disease causes hypertension.

Brain blocked-vessel infarction versus ruptured-vessel hemorrhage, intracerebral versus subarachnoid bleeding, coronary flow problems/angina/myocardial infarction, arteriosclerosis wall change versus one BP number, and retinal/brain/heart/kidney/whole-vessel evaluation retained without worker diagnosis.

Salt/activity/medication policy follows own treatment/support plan; care worker never independently stops or changes medication amounts despite feeling well. Measured values/baseline changes/resident words are communicated concretely.

Body divisions and specific names preserve head/neck/trunk/upper/lower limb, chest/abdomen, inner/outer eye corner, forehead/chin, outside neck/throat, arm/wrist/finger/tip, palm/dorsum, ankle/toe/heel/sole/dorsal foot, low back versus whole back and two buttock aliases. Japanese body terms/kana remain intentional learning references with complete Burmese meaning.

Left/right is resident-based, not worker-facing. Affected and contrasting good side are not fixed left/right or a guarantee the good side is problem-free. Report part/side/time/resident words separately, no inferred severity/cause and no delay for all questions in sudden change.

CNS brain/spinal cord versus peripheral information links, brain processing/decision/commands,12cranial and31spinal pairs versus single nerve counts retained; sensory body→central and motor central→body plus spinal reflex/bidirectional information preserved.

Distribution-map position labels are not names of individual nerve pairs; diagram alone does not diagnose numbness/movement difficulty. Actual part/time/resident words are passed for individual evaluation.

Cerebrum/cerebellum functions distinguished; midbrain/pons/medulla belong to brainstem with heart/respiration/swallow life functions; diencephalon thalamus/hypothalamus distinct from cerebellum/brainstem. Hypothalamus autonomic/temperature/sleep regulation retained.
Interconnected brain parts do not imply one action/emotion determined solely by one site; model names are foundational knowledge, not self-localization diagnosis from symptoms.

Autonomic sympathetic and parasympathetic activity/tension versus rest/recovery tendencies retained as context-dependent regulation. Heart faster/slower directions are not actual unmeasured pulse numbers.

Sympathetic role in many peripheral vessels/tone/possible constriction and multiple BP factors retained; not universal fully symmetric opposing actions in all organs. Anxiety is mental-state observation, not measured BP rise; no invented values from physiology.

Pupil dilation/constriction model concerns light quantity, not neural examination instruction; digestive inhibition/promotion not sole cause of eating/elimination; bronchial dilation/constriction not independent breathlessness diagnosis or medication selection.

Eccrine sweating retains important sympathetic input; more/less teaching contrast is not direct parasympathetic sweat-gland stopping or perfect symmetry. Organ-specific model limits, observation versus inferred cause and professional consultation preserved.
All28specific option rationales preserve why generally true distractor facts do not answer current question; no generic one-line rationale replacing source reasons.
